description: Store construction planned-unit counts as numeric Param values with source unit number formats; leave construction Details blank.

before.formula:
=LET(
  details, LET(
  period, A2,
  selected, D2,
  expense_type, F2,
  all_periods, OR(selected="All Month", selected="All Quarters", selected="All Years"),
  months, FILTER(R_MONTHS, ISNUMBER(R_MONTHS)),
  labels, ARRAYFORMULA(IF(period="Month", TEXT(months, "mmm yyyy"),
    IF(period="Quarter", "Q"&ROUNDUP(MONTH(months)/3)&" "&YEAR(months),
      TEXT(months, "yyyy")))),
  IF(AND(NOT(all_periods), SUM(ARRAYFORMULA(N(labels=TO_TEXT(selected))))=0), "",
    LET(
      selected_months, FILTER(months, IF(all_periods, ISNUMBER(months), labels=TO_TEXT(selected))),
      without_totals, LAMBDA(expenses, source,
        LET(
          categories, ARRAYFORMULA(IFNA(XLOOKUP(CHOOSECOLS(expenses, 2),
            COL_VALUES(source, "param"), COL_VALUES(source, "_category")), "")),
          IFNA(FILTER(expenses, ARRAYFORMULA(LOWER(TRIM(categories))<>"totals")), {"","","",""})
        )
      ),
      infra_details, LAMBDA(month,
        LET(
          source, S_INFRA_EXP_P,
          params, COL_VALUES(source, "param"),
          suppliers, COL_VALUES(source, "supplier"),
          categories, COL_VALUES(source, "_category"),
          values, CHOOSECOLS(DATA_ROWS(source), MATCH(month, HEADER_ROW(source), 0)),
          IFNA(FILTER(
            HSTACK(ARRAYFORMULA(IF(params<>"", "Infrastructure", "")), params, suppliers, values),
            ARRAYFORMULA(LOWER(TRIM(categories))<>"totals"),
            ISNUMBER(values),
            values>0
          ), {"","","",""})
        )
      ),
      financing_details, LAMBDA(month, source, param_name, party_header, type_label,
        LET(
          params, COL_VALUES(source, "param"),
          names, COL_VALUES(source, "_name"),
          parties, ARRAYFORMULA(IFNA(XLOOKUP(names, COL_VALUES(source, "name"),
            COL_VALUES(source, party_header)), "")),
          values, CHOOSECOLS(DATA_ROWS(source), MATCH(month, HEADER_ROW(source), 0)),
          IFNA(FILTER(
            HSTACK(ARRAYFORMULA(IF(names<>"", type_label, "")), names, parties, values),
            params=param_name,
            ARRAYFORMULA(LOWER(TRIM(names))<>"totals"),
            ISNUMBER(values),
            values>0
          ), {"","","",""})
        )
      ),
      monthly_details, LAMBDA(month, IF(expense_type="Borrowing Repayments",
        financing_details(month, S_BORROWINGS, "borrowings repaid", "lender", "Borrowing Repayments"),
        IF(expense_type="Loan Disbursements",
          financing_details(month, S_LOANS, "loan disbursed", "debtor", "Loan Disbursements"),
        IF(expense_type = "Infrastructure Expenses", infra_details(month), IF(expense_type = "Setup Expenses", without_totals(SETUP_EXPENSES_D(month), S_SETUP_EXP_P),
    IF(expense_type = "Construction Expenses", CONSTRUCTION_EXPENSES_D(month),
      IF(OR(expense_type = "Direct Operating Expenses", expense_type = "Other Operating Expenses"),
        LET(
          operating, OPERATIONAL_EXPENSES_D(month),
          IFNA(FILTER(operating, CHOOSECOLS(operating, 1)=expense_type), {"","","",""})
        ),
        IF(expense_type = "Land Expenses", LAND_EXPENSES_D(month),
          IF(
            expense_type = "All",
            LET(
              all_expenses,
              VSTACK(
                without_totals(CONSTRUCTION_EXPENSES_D(month), S_CONSTRUCTION_EXP_P),
                infra_details(month),
                LAND_EXPENSES_D(month),
                financing_details(month, S_BORROWINGS, "borrowings repaid", "lender", "Borrowing Repayments"),
                financing_details(month, S_LOANS, "loan disbursed", "debtor", "Loan Disbursements"),
                without_totals(OPERATIONAL_EXPENSES_D(month), S_OPERATIONAL_EXP),
                without_totals(SETUP_EXPENSES_D(month), S_SETUP_EXP_P)
              ),               
              FILTER(
                all_expenses,
                CHOOSECOLS(all_expenses, 1) <> ""
              )
            )
          )
        )
      )
    )
  ))))),
      LET(
        expenses, REDUCE({"",0,"","",0}, selected_months,
          LAMBDA(result, month,
            LET(
              monthly, monthly_details(month),
              VSTACK(result, HSTACK(
                CHOOSECOLS(monthly, 1),
                ARRAYFORMULA(IF(CHOOSECOLS(monthly, 1)<>"", month, "")),
                CHOOSECOLS(monthly, 2, 3, 4)
              ))
            )
          )),
        IFNA(QUERY(expenses,
          "select Col1, Col2, Col3, Col4, sum(Col5) where Col1 is not null group by Col1, Col2, Col3, Col4 order by Col1, Col2, Col3 label sum(Col5) ''", 0),
          {"","","","",0})
      )
    )
  )
),
  spacer, ARRAYFORMULA(IF(SEQUENCE(ROWS(details))>0, "", "")),
  type_labels, MAP(CHOOSECOLS(details, 1), LAMBDA(type,
    SWITCH(type,
      "Construction", "Construction Expenses",
      "Infrastructure", "Infrastructure Expenses",
      "Setup", "Setup Expenses",
      "Land", "Land Expenses",
      type)
  )),
  row_details, MAP(type_labels, CHOOSECOLS(details, 2), CHOOSECOLS(details, 3), CHOOSECOLS(details, 4),
    LAMBDA(type, month, param, detail,
      IF(type="Construction Expenses",
        LET(
          units, INDEX(CONSTRUCTION_PARAM_VALUES(REGEXREPLACE(param, " const[.] cost$", " const. count")),
            1, MATCH(month, R_MONTHS, 0)),
          TEXT(units, IF(units=INT(units), "0", "0.########")) & IF(units=1, " planned unit", " planned units")
        ),
        detail
      )
    )),
  listed, HSTACK(type_labels, CHOOSECOLS(details, 2), spacer, CHOOSECOLS(details, 3), spacer, row_details, CHOOSECOLS(details, 5)),
  total, HSTACK("Total", "", "", "", "", "", SUM(CHOOSECOLS(details, 5))),
  IF(SUM(ARRAYFORMULA(N(type_labels<>"")))=0, total, VSTACK(listed, total))
)
